moments.title: Premier League Season Kicks Off!
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season officially begins this week, with the first match on Friday and a full weekend of fixtures ahead.

angles.name: Anticipation
angles.copy: New season, new hopes! The Premier League is back this weekend. Who are you backing for the title this year?

angles.name: Opening Match
angles.copy: The 2026/27 Premier League season kicks off on Friday, August 21st! Get ready for goals, drama, and pure football action.

moments.title: Community Shield Showdown
moments.blurb: The traditional curtain-raiser to the English football season, the Community Shield, takes place this Sunday, August 16th, in Cardiff.

angles.name: Build-up
angles.copy: Cardiff hosts the Community Shield this Sunday, as the FA Cup holders take on the Premier League champions! Who's lifting the first silverware of the season?

angles.name: Local Angle
angles.copy: Big football coming to Cardiff this Sunday! The Community Shield takes over Principality Stadium. Are you heading down?

moments.title: Edinburgh Fringe Festival In Full Swing
moments.blurb: The world's largest arts festival, the Edinburgh Fringe, continues to draw huge crowds with thousands of shows across comedy, theatre, music, and more until August 31st.

angles.name: Festival Buzz
angles.copy: Edinburgh is alive with the sound of the Fringe! Thousands of incredible shows are running all month. What's been your favourite discovery so far?

angles.name: Scottish Highlight
angles.copy: It's all happening in Edinburgh! The Fringe Festival is in full swing, bringing the best (and weirdest) of the arts to Scotland's capital. What's on your must-see list?

moments.title: Green Man Festival Approaches
moments.blurb: Wales' largest music, arts, and science festival, Green Man, kicks off next weekend in the stunning Brecon Beacons, running August 20-23.

angles.name: Welsh Festival
angles.copy: The countdown is on for Green Man Festival! Next weekend, the Brecon Beacons will be buzzing with music, arts, and good vibes. Who's got their tickets ready?

angles.name: Music & Arts
angles.copy: Heading to Green Man? Next week, the Brecon Beacons come alive with an incredible line-up of indie, folk, and rock. Get ready!

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festival Soon!
